data.description:
## Context / Problem

A run behind an opaque gateway signs its verdict as `tier: "first_class"`.

`capabilities.py:307-311` derives the tier SOLELY from `cfg.base_url`:

    "tier": "best_effort" if base_url else "first_class"

But `KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES` (`config.py:214-241`) admits `gateway/anthropic`, `gateway/bedrock`,
`gateway/google-cloud`, `gateway/groq` and `gateway/openai`, and these are LIVE — they appear in
`_pydantic_ai_known_providers()` and `ProviderSession.provider_factory` delegates them to
`pydantic_ai.providers.infer_provider`.

A `gateway/anthropic:claude-opus-4-8` run carries NO `base_url`, so it is stamped `first_class` with
`endpoint_host: None` — even though every byte traversed Pydantic's AI Gateway, an intermediary that
can rewrite the request. The docstring one line above describes exactly this defect ("a run behind an
opaque gateway still claimed it came from `anthropic:claude-opus-4-8`") for the base_url case; the
`gateway/*` provider family slipped through the same hole.

WHY IT MATTERS HERE MORE THAN ELSEWHERE: rebar SIGNS verdicts and stamps the tier. The whole point of
the two-tier design is that an attestation consumer can tell how much to trust the provenance. A
gateway run stamped `first_class` misrepresents provenance in a signed artifact.

Third-party evidence that gateways do rewrite silently: the Vercel AI Gateway has been documented
silently downgrading Anthropic's 1-hour prompt cache
(danielternyak.com/articles/vercel-ai-gateway-downgrades-anthropic-prompt-cache).

## Approach

    tier = "best_effort" if (base_url or provider.startswith("gateway/")) else "first_class"

One line. Consider whether `endpoint_host` should also record the gateway rather than `None`, so the
provenance names the intermediary instead of omitting it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A `gateway/*` provider stamps `tier: "best_effort"`, proven by a test that fails before the fix.
- [ ] A direct provider with no `base_url` still stamps `first_class` — the existing behaviour is not
      collateral damage.
- [ ] It is decided and recorded whether `endpoint_host` should name the gateway rather than be `None`.
- [ ] make lint and make typecheck pass by exit code; the default selection is green.
data.title: A gateway/* provider signs as tier first_class, misrepresenting provenance in a signed verdict
